name: Mock Data Generator
description: Generate mock data by field type, covering strings, numbers, emails, phone numbers, names and more.

hints.types: With no type selected every type is generated.
hints.output: The response carries the random seed so the same batch can be reproduced.

faq.a: It is fake: emails always use example.com and numbers are not guaranteed to exist.

faq.q: Can I reproduce a previous batch?
faq.a: Yes, the seed in the response is the one used for that batch.
